newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX RISES 0.9 POINTS TO 766 PTS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX RISES 0.9 POINTS TO 766 PTS.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, rose 0.9 points, or 0.12 percent, on Thursday to 766.0, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices gained, with the trade index rising the most, up 5.4 points, or 2.26 percent, to 244.6 points.
Five indices lost, with the food index losing the most, down 8.7 points, or 0.82 percent, to 1,054.1 points.
